name: The Daily Hoodie
description: A little room. A lot of comfort.
detail: Easy volume, a soft neutral palette, and a hood that finishes the silhouette. Style it with charcoal trousers and a warm-toned sneaker. A fictional piece in the FORME portfolio collection.

name: Canvas High 01
description: Your everyday, from the ground up.
detail: A high-top canvas silhouette with a warm brown upper and a contrasting light sole. Give the ankle some space with a shorter hem, or let a relaxed trouser sit over the top. Styling imagery is used for this fictional portfolio collection.

name: The Relaxed Trouser
description: An easy fit, with somewhere to go.
detail: An easy, dark trouser with room through the leg. Balance the silhouette with a fitted tee, or lean into volume with a relaxed hoodie. A fictional piece in the FORME portfolio collection.

name: The Studio Cap
detail: A quiet finishing touch in a washed neutral tone. Pair it with sand, charcoal, or a single warm accent. A fictional accessory in the FORME portfolio collection; the photograph is an editorial styling reference.

name: The Weekend Hoodie
description: The same comfort. A brighter mood.
detail: A familiar shape, in the signature pumpkin mood. Let the color be the focal point and keep everything else easy. A fictional piece in the FORME portfolio collection.

name: The Everyday Low
detail: A low-profile sneaker in warm brown with a lighter sole. An easy finishing point for neutrals, relaxed trousers, and off-duty layers. A fictional piece in the FORME portfolio collection.

name: The City Layer
description: A sharper line. The same easy feeling.
detail: Soft tailoring meets the everyday wardrobe. Wear a sand-colored outer layer over a quiet base, then finish with your favorite sneakers. This is a fictional portfolio product with editorial styling imagery.

name: The Afterhours Set
description: For days that turn into nights.
detail: A coordinated utility-inspired silhouette in a warm rust tone. Wear it together for a strong outline, or separate the layers and bring them into the rest of your rotation. This is a fictional portfolio product with editorial styling imagery.
